 $$ \int \frac{d x}{x} = \log x. $$ 

 $$ \begin{array}{l} \int \frac {d x}{a + b x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {a b}} \tan^ {- 1} \left(x \sqrt {\frac {b}{a}}\right), \text {or} \int \frac {d x}{a ^ {2} + x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {1}{a} \tan^ {- 1} \frac {x}{a}. \end{array} $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {d x}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}}} = \sin^ {- 1} \frac {x}{a}. $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {- d x}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}}} = \cos^ {- 1} \frac {x}{a}. $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {d x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} \pm a ^ {2}}} = \log \frac {(x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} \pm a ^ {2}})}{a}. $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {d x}{\sqrt {\frac {2}{a} a x - x ^ {2}}} = \operatorname{vers} ^ {- 1} \frac {x}{a}. $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {d x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} \pm 2 a x}} = \log (x \pm a + \sqrt {x ^ {2} \pm 2 a x}). $$ 

 $$ \int \frac {d x}{x \sqrt {x ^ {2} - a ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{a} \sec^ {- 1} \frac {x}{a}. $$
